IV ventricle is normal & midline. Both cerebellar hemisphere &
region of brain stem are normal.
Focal small gliosis is seen in left basal ganglia.

3rdventricle & both lateral ventricles are prominent & shape
with septum in midline.
Elsewhere attenuation value of brain parenchyma is normal.

Both sylvian fissure , cortical sulci & basal cistern are
prominent.
**Focal small gliosis in left basal ganglia**.
